Introduction

KOYOTE, also known as KYT, is a South Korean co-ed group consisting of members Kim Jong-min, Shin Ji, and Bbaek Ga. The group, which is known for its signature dance and hip hop sound, debuted in 1998 with hit song "Genuine".

The group has gone through numerous line-up changes over the years, with Shin Ji being the group's only remaining original member.
